text:
If your Saturday plans can handle a little uncertainty, Burlington should turn out mostly pleasant, but keep a rain jacket nearby. We’re starting cloudy and cool, with clouds breaking for some sun and a high right around 73. The official call is only a slight shower chance after 2, but the European model is much wetter than the others, so I wouldn’t make a long outing without a backup plan. North winds will run 8 to 12 mph, and on the lake they’ll push 1 to 2 foot waves. The water is still a comfortable 71, but it won’t be a glassy afternoon.

Tonight clears some, with a low near 52. Sunday looks like the safer outdoor bet, sunny and near 73, though north winds stay noticeable and the lake remains a little choppy. Enjoy the dry stretch, because a wetter system is favored around midweek, followed by a cooler turn. For today, keep plans flexible after 2 and aim to be off the broad water if showers build.
